Say what replaces the area. If you only say what to remove, you can get a flat gray shape.

Wrong thing picked? The arrows under the picture swap it for the next thing it could mean. **Draw** paints an area by hand.

**Auto prompt** is on: the text encoder turns your words into a full prompt. **Prompt Krea 2 sees** shows it. Switch it off to send your words as typed.

Changing the background? Click **Background** under the picture. That button needs the last file in the list below. A small gap closed in by the person can stay a flat patch.

Change one thing per run. With two separate areas, only one may come out.

**Denoise** is how much of the picked area is replaced. 1 replaces all of it. Around 0.7 the new thing keeps the old shape. At 0.5 and under it stays close to what was there.

The three boxes in the middle do the work. Double-click one to see inside.

widgets_values:

###### Try to completely cover the area where you want changes made. You can use **Grow** to increase the size of the entire masked area and **Soften** to ease the blended areas.

nodes.title: Callout
widgets_values:

###### Lower it to keep some of what was there. The highest is 1.0 and lowest is 0.
###### 1.0 will be free to change anything and 0 will change nothing.

nodes.title: Krea 2 Outpaint Model Patch - Reference and placement
Stitch Inpaint - Put the new part back
Callout
widgets_values:
Krea 2 is shown the crop with the picked area in the picture's own colour.
###### Its inpaint LoRA was trained that way. The painting starts from the plain crop, so a denoise under 1 keeps some of what was there. Krea 2 paints only inside the noise mask: the picked area, widened by 24 px.

nodes.title: Instruction plus your request
widgets_values: Write one text-to-image prompt describing this picture as it will look when finished: one paragraph of 40 to 80 words covering the subject, setting, materials, lighting and camera style. The flat mid-gray area will be painted: never call it gray, blank, masked or painted, and describe it as part of the finished scene. Output only the prompt. What the gray area shows:

nodes.title: Describe the finished picture
widgets_values: Describe only the visible subject, setting, materials, composition and lighting in 60 to 90 words. Use plain factual language. Do not invent actions, camera motion, sound or objects. Output only the description.
